# Setup

Loads packages for frequency summaries, Bayesian Gompertz fits, and plots, and sets `knitr::opts_chunk$set(error = FALSE)`.

```{r packages, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(brms)
library(ggeffects)
library(ggrepel)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)
```

```{r knitr_options}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(error = FALSE)
```

# Load Data

Loads `japanese_tokens_processed` from the processed Feather file with token, category, speaker, age, and negation-scope columns. Creates `japanese_data_dir` and `japanese_model_dir` for saved tables and models.

```{r processedTokens}
japanese_data_dir <- "../japanese/japanese_data/processed_data"
japanese_model_dir <- "../japanese/japanese_model/modeling"
dir.create(japanese_model_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(japanese_data_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Only the columns needed for counting, to keep memory down.
japanese_tokens_processed <- read_feather(
  file.path(japanese_data_dir, "japanese_tokens_processed.feather"),
  col_select = c(utterance_id, token_order, speaker, age, word, word_category,
                 syncategory, negation_category, negation_scope)
)

japanese_negation_words <- c("nai", "iya")
```

# Calculate Relative Frequencies

Calculates monthly and cumulative rates from `japanese_tokens_processed` by speaker and age. Sets child ages 0–10 to zero and excludes later zero-occurrence months from individual negator rates.

## Target Negator and Other Token Rates

Calculates monthly `pct` and cumulative `cumulative_pct` by `syncategory` in `japanese_syncategory_relfreq`. Saves the table for `Function` target negators and `nonfunction` retained tokens.

```{r syncategory_relfreq}
japanese_syncategory_relfreq <- japanese_tokens_processed %>%
  group_by(syncategory, speaker, age) %>%
  summarise(freq = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  complete(nesting(speaker, age), nesting(syncategory), fill = list(freq = 0L)) %>%
  complete(nesting(syncategory) %>% mutate(speaker = "child"), age = 0:10, fill = list(freq = 0)) %>%
  mutate(freq = ifelse(speaker == "child" & age <= 10, 0, freq)) %>%
  group_by(speaker, age) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(freq), relfreq = ifelse(total == 0, 0, freq / total), pct = relfreq * 100) %>%
  group_by(syncategory, speaker) %>%
  arrange(age) %>%
  mutate(cum_freq = cumsum(freq),
         cum_total = cumsum(total),
         cumulative_relfreq = ifelse(cum_total == 0, 0, cum_freq / cum_total),
         cumulative_pct = cumulative_relfreq * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(syncategory, speaker, age, freq, total, relfreq, pct,
         cum_freq, cum_total, cumulative_relfreq, cumulative_pct)

saveRDS(japanese_syncategory_relfreq, file.path(japanese_data_dir, "japanese_syncategory_relfreq.RDS"))
```

## Individual Negator Rates

Calculates monthly `ppt` and cumulative `cumulative_ppt` by `word` in `japanese_functionword_relfreq`. Retains child ages 0–10 and later months with positive counts in each word-specific cumulative denominator.

```{r functionword_relfreq}
# Tokens per speaker and month: the denominator for every rate (ages 0-10 set to zero).
japanese_speaker_age_totals <- japanese_tokens_processed %>%
  count(speaker, age, name = "total") %>%
  mutate(total = if_else(speaker == "child" & age <= 10, 0L, total))

japanese_functionword_relfreq <- japanese_tokens_processed %>%
  group_by(word, speaker, age) %>%
  summarise(freq = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  complete(nesting(word) %>% mutate(speaker = "child"), age = 0:10, fill = list(freq = 0)) %>%
  mutate(freq = ifelse(speaker == "child" & age <= 10, 0, freq)) %>%
  left_join(japanese_speaker_age_totals, by = c("speaker", "age")) %>%
  mutate(total = replace_na(total, 0L),
         relfreq = ifelse(total == 0, 0, freq / total),
         ppt = relfreq * 1000) %>%
  filter(freq > 0 | (speaker == "child" & age %in% 0:10)) %>%
  group_by(word, speaker) %>%
  arrange(age) %>%
  mutate(cum_freq = cumsum(freq),
         cum_total = cumsum(total),
         cumulative_relfreq = ifelse(cum_total == 0, 0, cum_freq / cum_total),
         cumulative_ppt = cumulative_relfreq * 1000) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(word, speaker, age, freq, total, relfreq, ppt,
         cum_freq, cum_total, cumulative_relfreq, cumulative_ppt)

saveRDS(japanese_functionword_relfreq, file.path(japanese_data_dir, "japanese_functionword_relfreq.RDS"))
```

## Negation Category Rates

Calculates monthly `ppt` and cumulative `cumulative_relfreq` by `word_category` in `japanese_wordcategory_relfreq`. Saves the `Negation` and `nonfunction` category rates.

```{r wordcategory_relfreq}
japanese_wordcategory_relfreq <- japanese_tokens_processed %>%
  group_by(word_category, speaker, age) %>%
  summarise(freq = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  complete(nesting(speaker, age), nesting(word_category), fill = list(freq = 0L)) %>%
  complete(nesting(word_category) %>% mutate(speaker = "child"), age = 0:10, fill = list(freq = 0)) %>%
  mutate(freq = ifelse(speaker == "child" & age <= 10, 0, freq)) %>%
  group_by(speaker, age) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(freq), relfreq = ifelse(total == 0, 0, freq / total), ppt = relfreq * 1000) %>%
  group_by(word_category, speaker) %>%
  arrange(age) %>%
  mutate(cum_freq = cumsum(freq),
         cum_total = cumsum(total),
         cumulative_relfreq = ifelse(cum_total == 0, 0, cum_freq / cum_total)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(word_category, speaker, age, freq, total, relfreq, ppt,
         cum_freq, cum_total, cumulative_relfreq)

saveRDS(japanese_wordcategory_relfreq, file.path(japanese_data_dir, "japanese_wordcategory_relfreq.RDS"))
```

# Plot and Fit Growth Curves

Plots speaker-level negation rates and fits Bayesian Gompertz curves to child `pct` and `cumulative_ppt` trajectories. Produces fitted child data and lag summaries for onset comparisons.

## Overall Negation

Plots monthly `pct` from `japanese_negation_words_relfreq` by `speaker` and fits `japanese_negation_words_lagModel` to child values. Saves `japanese_negation_words_childdata` with `predictions` and displays the fitted curve.

```{r negation_words_plot, echo=FALSE}
japanese_negation_words_relfreq <- japanese_wordcategory_relfreq %>%
  filter(word_category == "Negation") %>%
  mutate(pct = relfreq * 100) %>%
  arrange(speaker, age)

japanese_negation_words_plot <-
  japanese_negation_words_relfreq %>%
  ggplot(aes(age, pct)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid(. ~ speaker) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Overall Negation Production", x = "Age (Months)", y = "Monthly Percent of Tokens") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 14))

japanese_negation_words_plot
```

```{r negation_words_growth_model, include=FALSE}
japanese_negation_words_childdata <- japanese_negation_words_relfreq %>%
  filter(speaker == "child", is.finite(age), is.finite(pct)) %>%
  arrange(age)

if (nrow(japanese_negation_words_childdata) == 0L || !any(japanese_negation_words_childdata$freq > 0)) {
  stop("No retained child negation tokens are available for modeling.")
}

japanese_negation_words_lagModel <- brm(
  bf(pct ~ upperAsymptote * exp(-exp(((growthRate*exp(1))/upperAsymptote)*(lag-age)+1)),
     upperAsymptote ~ 1,
     growthRate ~ 1,
     lag ~ 1,
     nl = TRUE),
  data = japanese_negation_words_childdata,
  prior = c(
    prior(uniform(0, 100), nlpar = "upperAsymptote", lb = 0, ub = 100),
    prior(uniform(0, 10), nlpar = "growthRate", lb = 0, ub = 10),
    prior(uniform(10, 72), nlpar = "lag", lb = 10, ub = 72)
  ),
  file = file.path(japanese_model_dir, "japanese_negation_words_lagModel"),
  file_refit = "on_change",
  iter = 10000,
  seed = 16)
```

```{r negation_words_predictions}
japanese_negation_words_childdata$predictions <-
  fitted(japanese_negation_words_lagModel, newdata = japanese_negation_words_childdata)[, "Estimate"]

saveRDS(japanese_negation_words_childdata, file.path(japanese_data_dir, "japanese_negation_words_childdata.RDS"))
```

```{r negation_words_prediction_plot}
japanese_negation_words_plot <-
  ggplot(japanese_negation_words_childdata, aes(x = age, y = pct)) +
  geom_point(color = "black", size = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = predictions), color = "blue", linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 72, 12)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Overall Negation Production", x = "Child Age (Months)", y = "Monthly Percent of Tokens") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14)
  )

saveRDS(japanese_negation_words_plot, file.path(japanese_data_dir, "japanese_negation_words_plot.RDS"))

japanese_negation_words_plot
```

## Individual Negators

Plots `cumulative_ppt` for `nai` and `iya` by `speaker` and fits child Gompertz curves. Saves fitted child tables and model objects for the word onset comparison.

### nai

Plots `cumulative_ppt` for `nai` and fits `japanese_nai_lagModel` to child data. Saves `japanese_nai_childdata` with `predictions` and records the model lag summary.

```{r nai_plot, echo=FALSE}
japanese_functionword_relfreq %>%
  filter(word == "nai") %>%
  ggplot(aes(age, cumulative_ppt)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid(. ~ speaker) +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("nai") +
  xlab("Age (Months)") + ylab("Cumulative Tokens per 1,000 Tokens")
```

```{r nai_growth_model, include=FALSE}
japanese_nai_childdata <- filter(japanese_functionword_relfreq, word == "nai", speaker == "child") %>% arrange(age)

# Upper-asymptote limit: twice the highest observed rate, at least 5.
japanese_nai_upper_bound <- max(5, ceiling(max(japanese_nai_childdata$cumulative_ppt, na.rm = TRUE) * 2))

japanese_nai_lagModel <- brm(
  bf(cumulative_ppt ~ upperAsymptote * exp(-exp(((growthRate*exp(1))/upperAsymptote)*(lag-age)+1)),
     upperAsymptote ~ 1,
     growthRate ~ 1,
     lag ~ 1,
     nl = TRUE),
  data = japanese_nai_childdata,
  prior = c(
    prior_string(paste0("uniform(0, ", japanese_nai_upper_bound, ")"), nlpar = "upperAsymptote", lb = 0, ub = japanese_nai_upper_bound),
    prior(uniform(0, 10), nlpar = "growthRate", lb = 0, ub = 10),
    prior(uniform(10, 72), nlpar = "lag", lb = 10, ub = 72)
  ),
  file = file.path(japanese_model_dir, "japanese_nai_lagModel"),
  file_refit = "on_change",
  iter = 10000,
  seed = 16)
```

```{r nai_predictions}
japanese_nai_childdata$predictions <- fitted(japanese_nai_lagModel, newdata = japanese_nai_childdata)[, "Estimate"]

saveRDS(japanese_nai_childdata, file.path(japanese_data_dir, "japanese_nai_childdata.RDS"))
```

```{r nai_age_of_production}
japanese_nai_lag <- fixef(japanese_nai_lagModel)["lag_Intercept", ]

japanese_nai_age_of_production <- tibble(word      = "nai",
                                         Estimate  = round(japanese_nai_lag["Estimate"], 1),
                                         Est.Error = round(japanese_nai_lag["Est.Error"], 1),
                                         Q2.5      = round(japanese_nai_lag["Q2.5"], 1),
                                         Q97.5     = round(japanese_nai_lag["Q97.5"], 1))
```

```{r nai_prediction_plot}
japanese_nai_plot <-
  ggplot(japanese_nai_childdata, aes(x = age, y = cumulative_ppt)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = "Actual Data"), size = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = predictions, color = "Fitted Values"), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Legend", values = c("Actual Data" = "black", "Fitted Values" = "blue")) +
  theme_bw() + labs(title = "nai", x = "Child Age (Month)", y = "Cumulative Tokens per 1,000 Tokens") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14)
  )

japanese_nai_plot
```

## Sentential and Discourse Negation

Calculates scope-specific `cumulative_ppt` and fits child Gompertz curves by `negation_scope` and `negation_category`. Saves fitted child tables and scope onset summaries.

### Calculate Scope Rates

Calculates `cumulative_ppt` by `negation_scope` and `negation_category` from `japanese_tokens_processed` against `japanese_speaker_age_totals`. Saves `japanese_scope_relfreq`.

```{r negation_scope_data}
japanese_scope_relfreq <- japanese_tokens_processed %>%
  filter(!is.na(negation_category)) %>%
  group_by(negation_scope, negation_category, speaker, age) %>%
  summarise(freq = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  complete(nesting(negation_scope, negation_category) %>% mutate(speaker = "child"), age = 0:10, fill = list(freq = 0)) %>%
  mutate(freq = ifelse(speaker == "child" & age <= 10, 0, freq)) %>%
  left_join(japanese_speaker_age_totals, by = c("speaker", "age")) %>%
  mutate(total = replace_na(total, 0L),
         relfreq = ifelse(total == 0, 0, freq / total),
         ppt = relfreq * 1000) %>%
  filter(freq > 0 | (speaker == "child" & age %in% 0:10)) %>%
  group_by(negation_scope, negation_category, speaker) %>%
  arrange(age) %>%
  mutate(cum_freq = cumsum(freq),
         cum_total = cumsum(total),
         cumulative_relfreq = ifelse(cum_total == 0, 0, cum_freq / cum_total),
         cumulative_ppt = cumulative_relfreq * 1000) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(negation_scope, negation_category, speaker, age, freq, total, relfreq, ppt,
         cum_freq, cum_total, cumulative_relfreq, cumulative_ppt)

saveRDS(japanese_scope_relfreq, file.path(japanese_data_dir, "japanese_negation_scope_relfreq.RDS"))

# Token counts behind each curve.
japanese_scope_relfreq %>%
  filter(speaker == "child") %>%
  group_by(negation_scope, negation_category) %>%
  summarise(n_tokens = sum(freq), n_months = sum(freq > 0), .groups = "drop")
```

### Fit Scope Curves

Fits Gompertz curves to scope series with positive `cumulative_ppt` and saves `japanese_sentential_negation_childdata` and `japanese_discourse_negation_childdata` with `predictions`.

```{r negation_scope_curve_data, include=FALSE}
# Gompertz curve on cumulative per-1,000 rates, with the same priors as the individual-word models.
fit_negation_gompertz <- function(child_data, model_path, seed = 16) {
  upper_bound <- max(5, ceiling(max(child_data$cumulative_ppt, na.rm = TRUE) * 2))
  brm(
    bf(cumulative_ppt ~ upperAsymptote * exp(-exp(((growthRate*exp(1))/upperAsymptote)*(lag-age)+1)),
       upperAsymptote ~ 1,
       growthRate ~ 1,
       lag ~ 1,
       nl = TRUE),
    data = child_data,
    prior = c(
      prior_string(paste0("uniform(0, ", upper_bound, ")"), nlpar = "upperAsymptote", lb = 0, ub = upper_bound),
      prior(uniform(0, 10), nlpar = "growthRate", lb = 0, ub = 10),
      prior(uniform(10, 72), nlpar = "lag", lb = 10, ub = 72)
    ),
    file = model_path,
    file_refit = "on_change",
    iter = 10000,
    seed = seed)
}

# Fit one model per word x scope with at least one token.
japanese_scope_groups <- japanese_scope_relfreq %>%
  filter(speaker == "child") %>%
  group_by(negation_scope, negation_category) %>%
  summarise(n_tokens = sum(freq), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_tokens > 0)

japanese_scope_models <- list()
japanese_scope_childdata <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(japanese_scope_groups))) {
  scope_i <- japanese_scope_groups$negation_scope[[i]]
  word_i <- japanese_scope_groups$negation_category[[i]]
  key_i <- paste(word_i, scope_i, sep = "_")

  childdata_i <- japanese_scope_relfreq %>%
    filter(speaker == "child", negation_scope == scope_i, negation_category == word_i) %>%
    arrange(age)

  model_i <- fit_negation_gompertz(childdata_i, file.path(japanese_model_dir, paste0("japanese_", key_i, "_lagModel")))
  childdata_i$predictions <- as.data.frame(fitted(model_i, newdata = childdata_i))[, "Estimate"]

  japanese_scope_models[[key_i]] <- model_i
  japanese_scope_childdata[[key_i]] <- childdata_i
}

japanese_scope_childdata_all <- bind_rows(japanese_scope_childdata)
japanese_sentential_negation_childdata <- filter(japanese_scope_childdata_all, negation_scope == "sentential")
japanese_discourse_negation_childdata <- filter(japanese_scope_childdata_all, negation_scope == "discourse")

saveRDS(japanese_sentential_negation_childdata, file.path(japanese_data_dir, "japanese_sentential_negation_childdata.RDS"))
saveRDS(japanese_discourse_negation_childdata, file.path(japanese_data_dir, "japanese_discourse_negation_childdata.RDS"))

# Observation-and-fit panels, one per word within a scope (matches Mandarin and English).
japanese_plot_child_negation <- function(plot_data, plot_title) {
  ggplot(plot_data, aes(age, cumulative_ppt)) +
    geom_point(color = "black", size = 2) +
    geom_line(aes(y = predictions), color = "blue", linewidth = 1, na.rm = TRUE) +
    facet_wrap(~ negation_category, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 72, 12)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
    labs(title = plot_title, x = "Child Age (Months)", y = "Cumulative Tokens per 1,000 Tokens") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 14)
    )
}
```

### Estimate Scope Onsets

Extracts `lag_Intercept` and 95% credible intervals from fitted scope models into `japanese_negation_scope_age_of_production`. Saves the scope onset table as RDS.

```{r scope_age_of_production}
extract_negation_lag <- function(model, language_name, word_name, category_name) {
  model_summary <- brms::fixef(model)
  if (!"lag_Intercept" %in% rownames(model_summary)) {
    stop("Cannot find lag_Intercept for ", language_name, ": ", word_name)
  }
  lag_summary <- model_summary["lag_Intercept", ]

  tibble(
    language = language_name,
    category = category_name,
    word = word_name,
    Estimate = unname(lag_summary["Estimate"]),
    Est.Error = unname(lag_summary["Est.Error"]),
    Q2.5 = unname(lag_summary["Q2.5"]),
    Q97.5 = unname(lag_summary["Q97.5"])
  )
}

japanese_negation_scope_age_of_production <- purrr::imap_dfr(japanese_scope_models, function(model, key) {
  parts <- str_split_fixed(key, "_", 2)
  extract_negation_lag(model, "Japanese", word_name = parts[, 1], category_name = str_to_title(parts[, 2]))
})

saveRDS(japanese_negation_scope_age_of_production,
        file.path(japanese_data_dir, "japanese_negation_scope_age_of_production.RDS"))

japanese_negation_scope_age_of_production
```

### Plot Sentential Curves

Plots observed `cumulative_ppt` and fitted `predictions` from `japanese_sentential_negation_childdata` by `negation_category`. Saves `japanese_sentential_negation_child_plot` as RDS.

```{r sentential_graph}

japanese_sentential_negation_child_plot
```

### Plot Discourse Curves

Plots observed `cumulative_ppt` and fitted `predictions` from `japanese_discourse_negation_childdata` by `negation_category`. Saves `japanese_discourse_negation_child_plot` as RDS.

```{r discourse_graph}
japanese_discourse_negation_child_plot <- japanese_plot_child_negation(
  japanese_discourse_negation_childdata, "Discourse Negation in Children"
)

saveRDS(japanese_discourse_negation_child_plot, file.path(japanese_data_dir, "japanese_discourse_negation_child_plot.RDS"))

japanese_discourse_negation_child_plot
```

### Plot Scope Onsets

Plots `japanese_negation_scope_age_of_production` lag estimates and 95% credible intervals separately for sentential and discourse categories. Saves `japanese_sentential_negation_onset_plot` and `japanese_discourse_negation_onset_plot` as RDS.

```{r categorize_onset}
plot_negation_scope_onset <- function(onset_data, category_name) {
  plot_title <- paste(unique(onset_data$language), category_name, "Negation")

  plot_data <- onset_data %>%
    filter(category == category_name, is.finite(Estimate)) %>%
    mutate(word = forcats::fct_reorder(word, Estimate))

  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0L) {
    return(ggplot() + theme_void() +
             annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = "No fitted lag estimate available") +
             labs(title = plot_title))
  }

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Estimate, y = word)) +
    geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = Q2.5, xmax = Q97.5)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 72, by = 6)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 72)) +
    labs(title = plot_title, x = "Fitted lag (months)", y = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12)
}

# Create the two plot objects.
japanese_sentential_negation_onset_plot <- plot_negation_scope_onset(japanese_negation_scope_age_of_production, "Sentential")
japanese_discourse_negation_onset_plot <- plot_negation_scope_onset(japanese_negation_scope_age_of_production, "Discourse")

# Save the plot objects for reuse in R.
saveRDS(japanese_sentential_negation_onset_plot, file.path(japanese_data_dir, "japanese_sentential_negation_onset_plot.RDS"))

saveRDS(japanese_discourse_negation_onset_plot, file.path(japanese_data_dir, "japanese_discourse_negation_onset_plot.RDS"))

# Display both graphs in the knitted document.
japanese_sentential_negation_onset_plot
japanese_discourse_negation_onset_plot
```

# Word Onset Estimates

Combines `japanese_nai_age_of_production` and `japanese_iya_age_of_production` into `japanese_age_of_production` and plots lag estimates with 95% credible intervals. Interprets these values as fitted lag parameters rather than observed first-production ages.

```{r age_of_production_build}
japanese_age_of_production <- bind_rows(
  japanese_nai_age_of_production,
  japanese_iya_age_of_production
) %>%
  arrange(Estimate) %>%
  mutate(word = fct_reorder(word, Estimate))

japanese_age_of_production
```

```{r age_of_production_plot}
japanese_negation_onsetage_plot <-
  japanese_age_of_production %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Estimate, y = word)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = Q2.5, xmax = Q97.5)) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 72, by = 3)) +
  labs(x = "Age (Months)", y = "") +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12))

japanese_negation_onsetage_plot
```
